title: When the app cannot close a member's open payment link, the desk payment is saved anyway and the link can still be paid
what: Before saving cash or UPI on Collect payment, the app asks the server to close any open online payment link for that due. If that ask fails (no internet, the server or payment company does not answer), the app carries on, saves the desk payment and says nothing. The link the member already has stays open, so they can pay the same due a second time. Today payment links are test mode only, so no real money moves yet; it bites once live payments are switched on.
expected: If the open links could not be closed, the desk is told that a payment link for this due may still be open and is asked to cancel it or tell the member not to pay it, before or right after the cash is saved.
how_often: each desk payment made while the link check fails and a link is open
fix_line: When the link check fails, warn the desk on the sheet and keep the warning on the member's page until the link is closed

title: Cancelling a receipt that was paid online does not give the member's money back, and the sheet never says so
what: The cancel-receipt sheet says the receipt stops counting as money received and the amount goes back onto the member's dues. For a receipt the member paid online through Razorpay or Cashfree, the money is still with the gym's payment company: nothing refunds it, and the sheet gives no hint to refund it there. The panel has no refund record at all; a refund and a typing mistake look the same apart from the typed reason. The member can then be chased for money they already paid.
expected: When the receipt was paid online, the sheet says the money stays with the payment company and asks whether it was refunded there, and the cancelled receipt shows whether money went back.
how_often: each cancelled receipt that was paid online
fix_line: Say on the cancel sheet when a receipt was paid online and record whether the money was refunded

title: After free days are added and then the start date is changed, the receipt shows the free days as paid
what: A plan that has not started can get free days (freeze or gift) and then have its start date changed. The start change keeps the day count, so the free days move with it, but the receipt reads the free-day note against the old end date, no longer matches, and falls back to printing the whole new period as what was paid, with no free-days line.
expected: The receipt keeps showing the paid period and the free days on their own line after a start date change.
how_often: rare: free days given before the plan starts, then the start moved
fix_line: Move the free-day note dates with the start change, or read the receipt's paid dates from the sale

title: The pass box says no plan and no dues, but a member switched to a pass keeps their old plan and any money they still owe
what: Ticking Comes with a pass shows the hint that the member has no plan and no dues. For an existing member, their earlier plan and any unpaid balance stay and still count in the dues total and on the Collect payment sheet. Only the renewal list leaves them out.
expected: The hint says that old plans and unpaid dues stay as they are, or the sheet shows what the member still owes when the box is ticked.
how_often: each time an existing member with dues is switched to a pass
fix_line: Change the hint to say old dues stay, and show the amount when there is one

items.reason: Sell, renew, PT, part payment, discount limits (10% desk, same rounding as the server), joining fee once, collect, freeze, start change, void and pass all read. Totals are plan price plus joining fee; prices are GST-inclusive in the receipt maths. No trial, founding offer, Play Billing or credits wallet in this area.

A test-mode online payment never becomes a receipt (guard before the sheet's save); the sheet's own test-mode note is never reached. Test-mode wording elsewhere is FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-03 and FN-A3-help-01.

Pending offline receipt is FN-A5-panel-forms-1-01; failed link close and refunded/void are new; late or double online payment is FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-05; cancelled plans block freeze and start change; ended plans can get days back.

Sheet total, still-due line, member dues and the receipt balance all use price plus joining fee minus non-cancelled receipts; HQ shows the stored amount and price as saved. Sent WhatsApp text not compared (no live send allowed).
